## Features

`crypto`, `default`, `dev`, `editor`, `emoji-picker`, `highlight`, `js`, `math`, `net`, `plot`, `rich-editor`, `shader`, `sound`, `svg`, `term`, `updater`, `websocket`, `webview`, `zlib`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p nsh-platform-linux
```
